newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-OSCAR'S PERFORMANCE KEEP BARCELONA HOPES ALIVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OSCAR'S PERFORMANCE KEEP BARCELONA HOPES ALIVE.

text.p: Barcelona maintained their outside chance of taking the Spanish championship on Monday thanks to reserve midfielder Oscar Garcia, who hit two spectacular goals in the 3-1 win at Celta Vigo.
With four games left, Barcelona are five points adrift of leaders Real Madrid, 1-0 winners over Valladolid on Sunday.
Oscar, only playing because of suspensions to first-choice players, struck from nearly identical positions outside the area in the 29th and 40th minutes.

Israeli striker Haim Revivo pulled one back for Celta in the 57th minute but shortly afterwards Ronaldo wrapped up the game with his 33rd game of the season after knocking in a rebound from his own header.
